Fieldwork

The city looks different from the street.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems in the built environment and work with the community, with a mentor checking the work along the way. Before the next floor plan, walk the block.

Learn more at earth5r.org
